roadmap.title: Route A as 2B
roadmap.description: Play the first route to Ending A. Along the way pick up the quick side unlocks, find Pod C and Pod B, finish the Half-Wit Inventor's investment quest, kill the three golden Machines in the City Ruins, and finish side quests before accepting the Missile Supply Mission, which cancels several of them.

roadmap.title: Route B as 9S
roadmap.description: Choose Continue to replay the story as 9S. Use hacking for the two hacking counters, open Hackable Chests for Archives and weapons, find the blacksmith Masamune, and finish Emil's Memories and any side quests left from Route A.

roadmap.title: Route C to the true ending
roadmap.description: Play as A2 and 9S. Earn the Berserk Mode kills, wipe Pascal's memory so he sells the Machine Heads weapon, collect the last Pod Programs, then finish the final boss as A2 and again as 9S and clear the credits mini-game. Refuse to delete the save data at the end.

roadmap.title: Chapter Select cleanup
roadmap.description: Use Chapter Select to finish the long collections: upgrade all three Pods, raise the other 38 weapons to Level 4, defeat Emil for the last weapon, and then collect the remaining joke endings, finishing with Ending Y.

achievements.description: Stare into space from the Bunker.
achievements.summary: Finish the Prologue, which ends once the Goliath-class boss falls for the last time.

steps.text: Play through the Prologue in the @loc{Abandoned Factory}. The achievement unlocks after you beat the Goliath-class boss for the last time.

achievements.summary: Arrive at the @loc{City Ruins} for the first time.

steps.text: After you leave the Flight Unit, climb onto the next building. The achievement unlocks when the cutscene of the @loc{City Ruins} ends.

achievements.summary: Defeat the boss that ends the main quest "The Machine Surge" inside the @loc{Desert Housing Complex}.

steps.text: Follow "The Machine Surge" into the @loc{Desert Housing Complex} and defeat the boss there.

achievements.summary: Defeat the @loc{Amusement Park} boss @enemy{Simone} and follow the friendly Machine to its village.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Simone}, the opera singer who is the @loc{Amusement Park} boss, and leave the arena.
Follow the friendly Machine that offers to guide you. The achievement unlocks just outside its village when the area cutscene starts.

achievements.summary: Win the fight against @enemy{Adam} and @enemy{Eve} in the alien ship.

steps.text: Follow the Route A main story into the alien ship and win the fight against @enemy{Adam} and @enemy{Eve}.

achievements.summary: Reach the Machine King in the @loc{Forest Castle} to finish the main quest "The Forest Kingdom".

steps.text: Play "The Forest Kingdom" through the @loc{Forest Castle} until you meet the Machine King.

achievements.summary: Defeat the colossal sea Machine in the @loc{Flooded City} to finish the main quest "Missile Supply Mission".

guide.context: Boarding the Flight Unit to start this mission cancels several open side quests for the current route, including "Anemone's Past", the Robo Dojo quests, and "Emil's Memories".

steps.text: In Route A, finish the side quest "Find a Present" before you go down into the @loc{Flooded City} for this mission. Also lend 50,000 G to the couple from "The Wandering Couple" at the Flooded City entrance before you receive the mission.
Board the Flight Unit to start the mission and defeat the colossal sea Machine.

achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Adam} in the @loc{Copied City}.

steps.text: Save at the @loc{City Ruins: Cave} Access Point, which is the last save point before the fight.
Enter the @loc{Copied City} and defeat @enemy{Adam}.

achievements.summary: Escape from the @loc{Abandoned Factory} after meeting @npc{Pascal} there in Route A.

guide.context: Accepting the Commander's email that sends you to meet @npc{Pascal} locks you into the end of Route A, so finish side quests first.

steps.text: Accept the Commander's email and meet @npc{Pascal} at the @loc{Abandoned Factory}.
Fight your way out of the factory. The achievement unlocks when you escape.

achievements.summary: Reach Ending A by defeating the final boss of Route A.

guide.context: During Route B, 2B carries whichever weapons you had equipped at the moment the final boss fell.

steps.text: Complete the last Route A main quest, "Threat Disposal", and defeat the final boss.

achievements.summary: Reach Ending B by finishing Route B as 9S.

steps.text: After Ending A, save over your file and choose Continue on the Main Menu to start Route B.
steps.note: Choosing New Game does not continue your save.

steps.text: Play Route B to the end and defeat @enemy{Eve}.
During the credits you control 2B in the @loc{Bunker}. Visit 9S, then return to her room to unlock the achievement.

achievements.summary: In Chapter 11 of Route C, cross the bridge as 9S and reach 2B at the @loc{Commercial Facility}.

steps.text: In Chapter 11, cross the bridge to the @loc{Commercial Facility} as 9S. The story scene there unlocks the achievement.

achievements.description: Control A2 for the first time.
achievements.summary: Choose A2 when Route C first lets you pick between A2 and 9S.

steps.text: Early in Route C the game asks whether to play as A2 or 9S. Pick A2.

achievements.summary: Grant @npc{Pascal}'s final request at the end of the Route C main quest "Pascal's Despair".

guide.context: If you wipe his memory, @npc{Pascal} later sells 9S the @item{Machine Heads} weapon for 10,500 G in his village. He does not sell it if you destroy him.

steps.text: As A2, finish "Pascal's Despair". When you decide what happens to @npc{Pascal}, choose to wipe his memory.

achievements.summary: Complete the Route C main quest "Obtain Keys", which stops every Resource Recovery Unit.

steps.text: Play "Obtain Keys" to its end in Route C.

achievements.description: Watch the final moments of Devola and Popola.
achievements.summary: Enter the @loc{Tower} as 9S after @npc{Devola} and @npc{Popola} defend him in the main quest "Tower Infiltration".

steps.text: In "Tower Infiltration", keep hacking the @loc{Tower} while @npc{Devola} and @npc{Popola} fight the Machines. The achievement unlocks when you control 9S again inside the Tower.
steps.note: It unlocks whether or not you read the text scene about the twins.

achievements.summary: Reach Ending D by defeating the final boss of Route C as 9S.

guide.context: The final fight lets you pick A2 or 9S. You need both endings, in either order.

steps.text: If you already have Ending C, open Chapter Select and load Chapter 17-09.
Pick 9S for the final boss fight and win.
Choose either Go or Stay. The achievement unlocks after the credits.

achievements.summary: Reach Ending C by defeating the final boss of Route C as A2.

steps.text: Pick A2 when the final boss fight asks you to choose a character, then win. The achievement unlocks after the credits.

achievements.summary: Finish the credits mini-game that plays once you have both Ending C and Ending D.

guide.context: After this ending the game offers to delete your save data to help other players. Accepting erases the save.

steps.text: Earn both Ending C and Ending D. The credits after the second one cannot be skipped.
Answer Yes when Pod 153 asks if you accept the Pod's request. Answer Yes again when asked if you still wish for them to survive.
Shoot your way through the credits. Each time you die, answer No to the question that follows so you keep playing.
At the final bosses, answer Yes when the game offers help after a death. The achievement unlocks when the mini-game ends.
Afterwards a Pod asks you to help the weak and then warns that helping costs your save data. Answer No to the save-data question.

achievements.summary: Retrieve your own body after you die.

steps.text: Die once, return to the spot where you died, and retrieve your body.
steps.note: The body holds the Plug-In Chips you had equipped.

achievements.summary: Retrieve 100 android bodies.

guide.context: With network features on, other players' bodies appear across the world. Offline, each area has only 2 or 3 preset bodies. They respawn, but the count rises far more slowly.

steps.text: Play with network features on and retrieve every body you pass until you reach 100.

achievements.summary: Complete any one side quest.

steps.text: At the @loc{Resistance Camp}, accept "The Supply Trader's Request" or "The Weapon Dealer's Request" and turn it in.

achievements.summary: Complete 48 of the 60 side quests, which is 80% of them.

guide.context: Most Route A and B side quests are unavailable in Route C. Boarding the Flight Unit to start "Missile Supply Mission" also cancels several open quests for the current route.

steps.text: Clear the side quests on your map during Routes A and B before you board the Flight Unit for "Missile Supply Mission".
Pick up the new side quests that appear in Route C.
If you are still short after Route C, use Chapter Select to replay earlier chapters and finish quests you missed.

achievements.summary: Unlock 138 of the 172 Unit Data entries, which is 80% of them.

guide.context: Unit Data covers enemies and NPCs, and one enemy type can have several variants. Route C adds the unit types missing from Routes A and B.

steps.text: Complete side quests and explore every area in all three routes. The achievement normally unlocks during Route C.

achievements.summary: Collect 44 of the 55 different Plug-In Chips, which is 80% of them.

guide.context: One PC player reported that the achievement only unlocked with 44 different chips in the inventory at the same time. Keep one of each chip until it unlocks.

steps.text: Buy the chips you do not own from shops, including @npc{Emil}'s shop.
Complete the side quest "Lord of the Valley" to open the item shop in the @loc{Forest Zone}, and buy its chips.
Retrieve the bodies of other players for more chips.

guide.context: @item{A130: Bomb} comes from a side quest that exists only in Route A. If you miss it, replay that chapter with Chapter Select after Route C.

achievements.description: Any weapon upgraded to the highest level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade any one weapon to Level 4, the highest level.

guide.context: Only the blacksmith @npc{Masamune} can upgrade a weapon to Level 4. That upgrade costs 10,000 G plus materials that differ for each weapon.

steps.text: In the @loc{Forest Castle}, go from the Royal Chamber Access Point back outside to the broken bridge.
Drop to the ledge below on the same side of the bridge. Walk to the dead end under the bridge and pull the stone block out to reach @npc{Masamune}.
steps.note: You must pull the block again on every visit.

steps.text: Have him raise one weapon to Level 4.
Afterwards, leave the conversation, talk to @npc{Masamune} again, and leave once more. He then gives you the @item{Cruel Lament} weapon.

achievements.description: All weapons upgraded to the highest level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade all 39 upgradeable weapons to Level 4.

guide.context: Bare Fists cannot be upgraded and do not count. Each weapon costs 17,500 G across its three upgrades, plus materials. Only @npc{Masamune} in the @loc{Forest Castle} does the Level 4 upgrade. You need 6 @item{Meteorite Shards}, which the Half-Wit Inventor in @loc{Pascal's Village} sells after you invest 180,000 G with him. The source guide warns he is gone in Route C, so finish that in Route A or B. After Route C, the Strange Resistance Woman in the @loc{Resistance Camp} also sells this achievement for G.

collectibles.method: Hack the door and take the weapon stuck in the sand.

collectibles.name: Demon's Cry
collectibles.method: After @enemy{Simone}, take the elevator in the left corner down. Hack the chest behind the stack of TVs.

collectibles.name: Type-4O Blade
collectibles.method: Complete "Data Analysis Freak" for Operator 21O in the @loc{Bunker}, then its sequel.
collectibles.note: The quest is offered in Route B.

collectibles.name: Beastcurse
collectibles.method: Hack the chest on the top floor.

collectibles.name: Cruel Lament
collectibles.method: Upgrade any weapon to Level 4. Then leave the conversation, talk to him again, and leave once more.

collectibles.name: Angel's Folly
collectibles.location: @npc{Emil}'s shop on his Resistance Camp route
collectibles.method: Buy the weapon for 25,000 G when he carries his rare stock.
collectibles.note: To roll the rare stock, buy something from Emil once. Cross the bridge to the Commercial Facility entrance, run back to the old radio tower, and check the map for his icon by the Resistance Camp. Check his stock and try again until it is the rare one.

collectibles.name: Type-3 Fists
collectibles.location: @npc{Emil}'s shop on his Resistance Camp route
collectibles.method: Buy the weapon from the same rare stock.
collectibles.note: Sources list its price as 20,000 G or 25,000 G.

collectibles.name: Machine Heads
collectibles.method: As 9S, buy the weapon from @npc{Pascal} for 10,500 G.
collectibles.note: He sells it only if you wiped his memory.

collectibles.name: Cruel Arrogance
collectibles.method: As 9S, run back along the roof of the small conveyor tunnel and hack the door at its end.

collectibles.name: Faith
collectibles.location: @loc{Flooded City} Soul Box, ring room of chests
collectibles.method: During "Obtain Keys", open the second chest on the right.

collectibles.name: Emil Heads
collectibles.method: Raise the other 38 weapons to Level 4 first. Then take @item{Emil's Head} from the chest at his house as 9S and defeat @npc{Emil}.

achievements.description: All Pods upgraded to the highest level.
achievements.summary: Upgrade Pod A, Pod B, and Pod C to Level 4, the highest level.

guide.context: Each Pod needs one @item{Powerup Part S}, one @item{Powerup Part M}, and one @item{Powerup Part L} for its three upgrades. Only three Powerup Part S exist, so you cannot skip a source. The golden Machines in the @loc{City Ruins} do not return through Chapter Select. "Anemone's Past" and the Robo Dojo quests are offered only in Routes A and B.

steps.text: Find Pod B and Pod C.

In Route A, kill more than 1,000 enemies. After the main quest "Assault", look for three golden Machines in the @loc{City Ruins}: @enemy{Courageous Brother} and two gold Goliath Bipeds. Defeat them for the first @item{Powerup Part S}.
steps.note: If they are absent, check again after the main quest "The Forest Kingdom". One player report dates their appearance to that point.

steps.text: Accept "Anemone's Past" from @npc{Anemone} once she has given you "Missile Supply Mission". Complete the side quest before you board the Flight Unit for that mission. The reward is the second Powerup Part S.

Complete all five of Father Servo's Robo Dojo side quests. The last one, "Robo Dojo: Red Belt", rewards the third Powerup Part S. Finish them before you board the Flight Unit for "Missile Supply Mission" in that route.
steps.note: As 9S, two hacks defeat Father Servo quickly.

steps.text: Collect the three @item{Powerup Part M} from one chest and two Hackable Chests.
steps.note: Route B or C: the chest is halfway down the ledges right of the waterfall below the Forest Zone Center Access Point. Route C: one Hackable Chest is before the fourth elevator in the Flooded City Soul Box. Route C: return to the Copied City for the other, at the end of the straight path back from the Adam arena.

steps.text: In Route C, go to the @loc{Amusement Park} square and attack its Golden Rabbit statue until it wakes. Then destroy the statue for a @item{Powerup Part L}. Use that part on a Pod before you fight the statue again, because it drops none while you hold one.

Gather the other materials. You need 6 @item{Complex Gadgets}: 2 from the Route C side quest "Gathering Keepsakes", 3 from "Sorting Trouble 3", and 1 hidden in the @loc{City Ruins} stream that the Scanner finds.
Upgrade each Pod to Level 4 at the Maintenance Shop. The three levels cost 2,500 G, 5,000 G, and 10,000 G.
After Route C, the Strange Resistance Woman in the @loc{Resistance Camp} also sells this achievement for G.

achievements.summary: Complete your first hacking mini-game as 9S.

steps.text: At the start of Route B, fly the Flight Unit as 9S until the game prompts you to hack an enemy. Finish that hacking mini-game.

achievements.summary: Destroy 100 Machines by hacking them as 9S.

steps.text: Throughout Route B, hack one or two enemies in every group you fight until the count reaches 100.

achievements.description: 50 machine lifeforms destroyed by remote control.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 Machines with a Machine that 9S controls through Remote Control.

guide.context: The hack menu with @mechanic{Remote Control} only appears when you hack a Machine that has not noticed you.

steps.text: Talk to 2B and set her Combat Style to Passive so she does not take your kills.
Go to the @loc{Amusement Park} and hack a parading Medium Biped before it notices you. Choose Remote Control.
Kill every Machine in the park with the controlled Machine.
Self Destruct the controlled Machine, transport away and back, and start again. Expect 1 to 3 runs.

achievements.description: 50 machine lifeforms destroyed with berserk mode.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 Machines as A2 while Berserk Mode is active.

guide.context: @mechanic{Berserk Mode} raises A2's damage and drains her health. It switches off at 1 HP.

steps.text: In Route C, activate Berserk Mode as A2 with the Self Destruct input, which is both sticks pressed in on a controller.
Kill Machines while Berserk Mode is active until the count reaches 50.
steps.note: The Deadly Heal chip offsets the health drain.

achievements.description: 255 enemies destroyed using a flight unit.
achievements.summary: Destroy 255 enemies while piloting a Flight Unit.

steps.text: Shoot down as many enemies as you can in every Flight Unit section of Route A. The count usually reaches 255 during "Missile Supply Mission".

achievements.description: Materials gathered at a hidden harvest point 10 times.
achievements.summary: Pick up 10 hidden items uncovered with the @item{A170: Scanner} Pod Program.

steps.text: Get the @item{A170: Scanner} program from @npc{Devola} and @npc{Popola} in the Route A story after the @loc{Flooded City}.
Use the Scanner as you travel. Its signal speeds up as you near a buried item. Pick up 10 of these items.

achievements.summary: Find Pod B and Pod C so that you own all 3 Pods.

guide.context: Pod A is the Pod you start with.

steps.text: Pod C: In the @loc{Desert Zone}, keep the rock wall on your left until you pass the way in to the Oil Field Access Point. Climb the tallest dune after it. The Pod lies a little below the top, on the side facing back toward the @loc{City Ruins}.
Pod B: In the @loc{Flooded City}, go straight past the Coast Access Point to the open ocean. Fish there until you catch the Pod.
steps.note: Fish in the ocean, not the enclosed pools by the buildings. The source guide needed about 6 casts and fished with the HUD: Fishing Spots chip installed.

achievements.summary: Hold at least 100,000 G at one time.

steps.text: During Route A, complete side quests and sell fish and any item whose description says it can be exchanged for money.
Sell the 4 @item{Machine Cores} from the main quest, which bring 40,000 G together.
Wait to invest money with the Half-Wit Inventor until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Ride animals for a total of 5 kilometers.

steps.text: Buy @item{Animal Bait} for 100 G at the @loc{Resistance Camp}.
Place the bait near a Boar or a Moose and mount the animal.
Ride from the Resistance Camp to the waterfall into the valley and back three times. Each round trip is about 1.6 km.

achievements.summary: Catch 20 different kinds of fish.

guide.context: There are 41 kinds of fish. The @loc{Flooded City} holds most of them.

steps.text: Fish in the @loc{Flooded City}, the @loc{Sewers}, the Desert oil field, and the @loc{City Ruins} stream outside the @loc{Resistance Camp} until you have 20 kinds.
steps.note: The source guide fishes with the HUD: Fishing Spots chip installed.

achievements.summary: Destroy 10 friendly Machines.

steps.text: Destroy 10 of the friendly Machines in the @loc{Amusement Park}.
steps.note: They are not quest characters, and they respawn when you leave and return.

achievements.summary: Look up 2B's skirt with the camera 10 times.

steps.text: As 2B, stand still and tilt the camera to look up under her skirt from the front. Hold the view until she swipes at the camera and resets it. Do this 10 times.

achievements.description: 1 hour played with 9S in a certain state.
achievements.summary: Play as 9S without his shorts for a total of 1 hour.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Dress Module} for 10,000 G from @npc{Emil}'s rare stock on his Resistance Camp route. Choose Use on it, not Equip.
Play as 9S for one hour in total. The time does not have to be one sitting.
steps.note: Without the Dress Module, Self Destruct as 9S instead. This also removes his shorts but leaves him almost dead, so wait somewhere safe such as the Resistance Camp.

achievements.description: Emil's shop used for the first time.
achievements.summary: Open @npc{Emil}'s shop inventory for the first time.

steps.text: After the forest part of the Route A story, find the mask icon on the @loc{City Ruins} map. If it is missing, transport to another City Ruins Access Point.
Shoot @npc{Emil}'s moving cart with Pod fire to stop it. Talk to him, open his inventory, and close it. You do not need to buy anything.

achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Emil} in the cave fight that follows taking @item{Emil's Head} from his house.

guide.context: @npc{Emil} attacks at Level 99. The source guide reports wins between Level 65 and 78. Make the second visit to his house only after your other 38 weapons are at Level 4, because doing it earlier can lock you out of Ending Y.

steps.text: Complete the side quest "Emil's Memories".
In the @loc{City Ruins}, stand on the roof of the small square building above the Cave Access Point. Glide left into the large pipe that pours water and ride the elevator down.
Drop to the lake at the bottom of the gorge. Go past it to the end of the lower cavern and through the doors to Emil's house.
Pick up the @item{Emil Mask} on the ground in front of the mask rack. Then talk to @npc{Emil}, who says he has tightened security.
Return to the house as 9S and hack the chest now in front of it to take @item{Emil's Head}.
steps.note: If the chest is missing, pick up the mask and talk to Emil again.

steps.text: Defeat @npc{Emil} when he attacks on your way out. Stay close so he uses his melee attack, which is easier to evade than his ranged attacks.
steps.note: He also drops the Emil Heads weapon.

steps.text: After Route C, the Strange Resistance Woman in the @loc{Resistance Camp} also sells this achievement for G.

achievements.summary: Earn all 26 endings, A through Z.

guide.context: Most lettered endings are instant game-over scenes that send you back to the title screen or your last save, so save first. Chapter Select opens after Route C and reaches any ending you missed. After Route C, the Strange Resistance Woman in the @loc{Resistance Camp} also sells this achievement for G.

collectibles.name: Ending W
collectibles.method: Die during the Prologue.

collectibles.name: Ending T
collectibles.method: In the Skills menu, open Plug-In Chips, pick Set Type A, then Customize, then Equipped Chips. Remove the @item{OS Chip}.

collectibles.name: Ending H
collectibles.method: When you are ordered to intercept the Goliath in the @loc{City Ruins}, walk toward the @loc{Amusement Park} instead. Ignore the Pod's warnings.

collectibles.name: Ending U
collectibles.method: Self Destruct while you are inside the Bunker.

collectibles.name: Ending K
collectibles.method: After the alien ship, a Resistance member here gives you a @item{Mackerel}. Eat the Mackerel.
collectibles.note: A Mackerel you fish up works too.

collectibles.name: Ending N
collectibles.method: Destroy all 32 Machines in the village, including @npc{Pascal}.
collectibles.note: There are 11 on the lower level, 6 on the middle level, 13 on the top level, 1 guard at the back exit, and 1 down a small ladder off the top level. The Half-Wit Inventor does not count.

collectibles.name: Ending I
collectibles.method: After you defeat the boss, walk away from 9S and leave the Copied City.

collectibles.name: Ending J
collectibles.method: Kill the Machine priest who greets you. Do not hurt any other Machine.

collectibles.name: Ending L
collectibles.method: When you find the camp under attack, turn around and leave the camp.

collectibles.name: Ending A
collectibles.method: Defeat the final boss of Route A.

collectibles.name: Ending G
collectibles.method: As 9S, skip the Flight Unit. Use the console on the left of the upper platform to lower a crane, then walk out to the crane's tip.

collectibles.name: Ending F
collectibles.method: After 9S is shot down, do not repair him. Wait until the 3-minute timer expires.

collectibles.name: Ending B
collectibles.method: Finish Route B.

collectibles.name: Ending O
collectibles.method: When 2B and 9S regroup on the bridge, turn around as 2B and follow the bridge to the factory.

collectibles.name: Ending P
collectibles.method: Let System Corruption reach 100%.
collectibles.note: Stepping a few paces onto the bridge toward the Commercial Facility jumps it to 90%.

collectibles.name: Ending X
collectibles.method: When you first control A2, turn back and cross the bridge into the @loc{City Ruins}.

collectibles.name: Ending Q
collectibles.method: Stay away from 2B at the Commercial Facility. Head for the desert or the @loc{Resistance Camp} instead.

collectibles.name: Ending Z
collectibles.method: As A2, destroy the Goliath @enemy{Hegel}, then clear the Machines attacking @npc{Pascal}. Talk to him and choose Destroy Pascal.

collectibles.name: Ending M
collectibles.method: When A2 is sent to rescue Pascal's Village, run to the far back of the Resistance Camp instead.

collectibles.name: Ending R
collectibles.method: In the first room, do not talk to @npc{Pascal} a second time. Destroy the friendly Machines in the room.

collectibles.name: Ending S
collectibles.method: When @npc{Devola} and @npc{Popola} arrive, run away and leave the City Ruins.

collectibles.name: Ending V
collectibles.method: Stay in the pit by the Tower without hacking until the twins are overwhelmed. This takes a few minutes.

collectibles.name: Ending C
collectibles.method: Defeat the final boss as A2.

collectibles.name: Ending D
collectibles.method: Defeat the final boss as 9S.

collectibles.name: Ending E
collectibles.location: Credits after Endings C and D
collectibles.method: Clear the credits mini-game and refuse to delete your save data. Then accept the prompt to save Ending E.

collectibles.name: Ending Y
collectibles.method: With all 39 weapons at Level 4, talk to @npc{Emil} at the Commercial Facility. Defeat him in the Desert Zone, then let his Self Destruct countdown run out without attacking.
collectibles.note: Attacking during the countdown ends the quest without the ending. Save before the fight.

achievements.description: The place of memories has been visited.
achievements.summary: Complete the side quest "Emil's Memories".

guide.context: The quest closes for the current route when you board the Flight Unit for "Missile Supply Mission".

steps.text: Follow the quest marker inside the @loc{Commercial Facility}, which is part of the @loc{City Ruins}, and find the @item{Lunar Tear} there. @npc{Emil} asks you to find four more.
Find the other four Lunar Tears. They are in the @loc{Forest Zone}, @loc{Flooded City}, @loc{Amusement Park}, and @loc{Desert Zone}.
steps.note: Desert: in the caverns, take the path left then down from the entry and hop across the sandstone. Forest: in the small cave with the Dragoon Lance chest. Amusement Park: next to the Shopkeeper Machine.

steps.text: Return to the Commercial Facility. Ride the elevator under the roots of the large tree in the middle, using the @item{Elevator Key} from Emil.
Talk to @npc{Emil} below to finish the quest.
